name: signtoenglish-web
description: Demo page for SignToEnglish: live captions from a local ASL-to-English translation service

scripts.dev: npm run gen && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.build: npm run gen && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build
scripts.lint: npm run gen && node scripts/check-pins.mjs && eslint .
scripts.typecheck: npm run gen && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next typegen && tsc --noEmit
